title: Surreal Melting Clock Kiss
description: A green-skinned woman with butterfly wings and a melting clock stands in an intimate embrace and kiss with a pink floral humanoid figure. They are positioned before a stone archway with dripping curtains, opening to a cosmic night sky featuring a crescent moon, floating jellyfish, a pineapple, and multiple melting clocks.
prompt: A surreal scene of a green-skinned woman with large butterfly wings and a melting pocket watch embracing and kissing a pink floral humanoid made of petals and eyes. They stand in front of a crumbling stone arch with dripping pink curtains. Through the arch is a cosmic purple sky with a crescent moon, floating jellyfish, and a large pineapple. Multiple melting clocks drip from the walls and arch. Hearts and eyeballs float in the air, liquid pools on the brick floor, in a vibrant psychedelic style.
